hero.title: Choose the platform you need.
hero.description: Public customers, registered customers and operations staff use separate frontend applications. Their data can connect through shared backend services without mixing navigation or page code.

platforms.title: Public landing site
platforms.description: Browse products, request quotations, complete checkout and contact the event team.

platforms.title: Customer account
platforms.description: A separate customer application for saved quotations, bookings, payments and messages.

platforms.title: Admin operations
platforms.description: A separate internal application for inventory, orders, logistics and reporting.

separation.title: Separate frontends. Shared business data.
separation.description: The public website never drops visitors into account or admin screens. Customer and admin applications are packaged and deployed independently, while approved APIs can share inventory, quotation and booking records.
